title: Established Specialty Therapy: Credit on Expedited Exception Approvals (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Credit.** Under the Formulary Benefit, an established-therapy credit is added to the exigency period of an expedited exception approval for members already being supplied the drug by the specialty pharmacy. The member's shipped specialty fills of the drug, recorded in the Specialty Pharmacy Program, are counted within the established lookback of **12** months. A fill is within the lookback when its ship date lies fewer whole months than 12 before the handling date.

| Shipped specialty fills of the drug within the lookback | Credit added |
|---|---|
| at least **6** (the established fill count) | **5** days |
| 1 to 5 | **2** days, the returning credit |
| none | nothing |

The credit is added to the exigency period before the floor of one day is applied.

*Hypothetical counts.* Monthly fills over the past year (12 shipped) earn 5 days, and so do exactly 6. Three fills earn 2 days. A single fill shipped 12 whole months before the handling date is outside the lookback and earns nothing.
